description: The file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, managing lifecycle events, UI setup with Jetpack Compose, permission handling, and interaction with a ViewModel and services.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the app's main UI, lifecycle, permissions, and start-up logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up lifecycle observers, permissions, and UI content.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity to foreground state within the ViewModel.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Sets the activity to background state within the ViewModel.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received while activity is running, possibly triggering assistant logic.

methods.name: handleAssistantIntent
methods.description: Processes an intent to determine if it is an assistant launch request and passes it to the ViewModel.
